messages:
emma: Quick heads-up  opened a small docs PR to refresh SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries (Py/TS/Go). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4289. Goal: 8-12 line runnable snippets, short v1->v2 migration note (next_cursor -> resume_token), expected output block. Please review.

kai: Ill take TS. Plan: tiny async iterator + `streamWithRetry` helper (3 retries, exp backoff) and a dedupe of partial tokens. Will keep it compact.

olivia: Ill do Python. Will include a generator wrapper, show where to persist `resume_token`, and add an Expected output section.

sam: Go snippet update ready: buffered channel, context cancel, extract `ResumeToken` and show a single-line comment about persisting. Kept example to ~10 lines.

deploy-bot: CI: docs/lint ✅, docs/build running (started at 3970012000)

emma: Tiny editorial: use `resume_token` in prose, `ResumeToken` in code; avoid lorem; use small payloads like {"query":"summarize: two lines"}. Also check docs auto-linker anchors before merge.

kai: Pushed TS patch. Fixed missing await in iterator. Local snippets harness passed.

olivia: Py pushed with Expected output block. Included before/after migration curl one-liner.

sam: Go pushed. Added brief note: "Persist ResumeToken after checkpoint to resume exactly-once."

deploy-bot: CI: docs/build ✅, examples/test-harness ✅ (completed at 3970017000)

emma: Merged after tiny formatting tweak. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
